Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 153. Category: stance. Stances.

Prerequisites: Dexterity 15+
A lighting fast fighting style based on sharp strikes
and battlefield control.
additional 15 movement speed
When you use the flurry of blows technique or “Wolf
Fang” techniques, increase the damage die by 1 step.
+1 Static Bonus to attack rolls when you make an
unarmed strike as your action.
